title: Motor City Machine Guns vs. Beer Money
summary: Alex Shelley and Chris Sabin finally capture the TNA tag titles, then must prove themselves against Beer Money in a best-of-five series. A two-match deficit turns into a championship comeback.

chapters.title: The Guns finally win the titles
chapters.result: The Motor City Machine Guns defeat Beer Money for the vacant TNA tag championships.
chapters.context: Shelley and Sabin secure their first TNA tag reign, but Storm and Roode immediately remain in the championship picture.

chapters.title: A three-to-two series comeback
chapters.show: TNA iMPACT! — The Whole F’N Show
chapters.result: The Guns win the deciding two-out-of-three-falls match and retain the titles.
chapters.context: After losing the first two series matches, Shelley and Sabin complete three straight wins. The television finale establishes their reign against TNA’s other elite team.
